_doc: dev-hooks.manifest.json — SSOT for the ecosystem repo's OWN dev hooks (DEF-CTX-4).
_why: These hooks are registered in <repo>/.claude/settings.local.json, which is GITIGNORED.
Before this manifest existed the registration lived on exactly one machine (the owner's
host): a fresh clone / VM / worktree / CI got NO dev hooks at all, and nobody noticed —
the hooks are fail-safe, so they fail by being silent. This file makes the wiring a
tracked, delivered artifact; install-dev-hooks.cjs applies it (npm `prepare`).
Contrast: hooks/<module>/manifest.yaml declares CONSUMER hooks (deployed to user projects
by /ecosystem:bootstrap, parsed by an LLM prompt → YAML). THIS manifest is parsed by CODE
on every `npm install` → JSON, so a malformed entry throws loudly instead of half-parsing.

_schema.file: basename inside dev/meta-improvement/hooks/ — MUST exist on disk (cross-checked)
_schema.event: Claude Code hook event: SessionStart | PostToolUse | SessionEnd | ...
_schema.matcher: optional — tool matcher for PostToolUse-class events (e.g. "Bash")
_schema.guard:
optional — "exists": wrap in `[ -f

] && node

|| true` (survives branches/worktrees where the file is absent)
_schema.register: optional, default true — false = deliberately NOT wired from this repo; MUST carry `why`
_schema.why: required when register=false — a dead mechanism is worse than an absent one; state the reason so the omission is auditable

_invariant: Every *.js in dev/meta-improvement/hooks/ MUST appear below (register true or false). install-dev-hooks.cjs --check enforces this and is wired into `npm run verify` — so a new hook file cannot silently miss delivery, which is the exact drift this manifest would otherwise re-introduce.

hooks.description: warn-only: a `git commit` that looks like a phase completion, with no phase-closure entry in DEV_JOURNAL.
warn-only: a non-trivial commit (feat/fix/spec/DEC-DEV) that did not touch DEV_JOURNAL.md.
warn-only, detect-only: HEAD touched a status-bearing doc ⇒ memory-sync is due (never writes — a self-editing hook would recurse).
regenerates the work-rails digest (RAILS.md) and injects it via additionalContext. Kill-switch: RAILS_AUTOGEN=0.
injects the context-map digest (docs/MAP.md + dev/INFORMATION-MAP.yaml) via additionalContext — push channel, DEC-DEV-0197 / D1.
surfaces standing D7 backlog conditions G25 / G26 / G27 (only the tripped arms print).

hooks.why: NOT wired from the ecosystem repo — it is registered from the PILOT project's own .claude/settings.local.json (an absolute path back into this repo) and writes session markers for the project it ran in. Auto-registering it here would make every ecosystem-repo session append rows to dev/meta-improvement/audit-index.md — a behaviour change nobody asked for. Declared explicitly so the omission is a recorded decision, not an oversight.
hooks.description: SessionEnd marker writer → dev/meta-improvement/audit-index.md Pending rows (consumed by /meta:audit-smoke).
